mentions.name: disposition
mentions.description: A Graphviz dot substitute written in pure Rust that renders graphs with predictable, stable layout, edge routing that avoids overlapping labels, dark and light mode styling via Tailwind CSS, interactivity implemented in pure CSS, and markdown support for descriptions.
mentions.problem: The original Graphviz dot lacks predictable/stable layout, dark and light mode CSS, pure-CSS interactivity, and markdown descriptions.
